summary: The workbook '02_multiple_sheets.xlsx' is an analytical model containing three sheets: 'Customers', 'Orders', and 'Reference'. The 'Customers' sheet holds master data for two customers (Aria Labs, Northwind) segmented as Enterprise and SMB. The 'Orders' sheet tracks two orders (ORD-1, ORD-2) with calculated customer names derived via VLOOKUP from the Customers sheet. The 'Reference' sheet (hidden) defines the meaning of the 'SMB' code. The model relies on cross-sheet lookup logic to populate customer names in the Orders table.
